visual.title: The loss after each step
visual.caption: Mean squared error averages the squared vertical gaps. The readout reports the actual loss at the current line, not a decorative score.

predict.question: What does mean squared error average?
predict.explain: MSE sums each squared prediction error and divides by the sample count.
